name: Centre Square
blurb: Everybody calls it the Circle. The Soldiers' and Sailors' Monument stands in the middle and becomes the Peace Candle every holiday season. On market days, the Easton Farmers' Market, going since 1752, sets up all around it.

name: Easton Public Market
_note: Hours from easton-pa.com. Confirm with the market before launch.
blurb: Lunch with options. Local food vendors under one roof, so everyone at the table gets what they want.

name: Crayola Experience
blurb: Right on the Circle. Bring the kids and expect them to leave a little more colorful than they came.

name: State Theatre
blurb: The grand old stage on Northampton Street. Touring shows, concerts and comedy most weeks.

name: Sigal Museum
blurb: Easton's story, from the Forks to now. A good hour, rain or shine.

name: Easton Area Public Library
blurb: Books, a quiet table and a children's room that earns its keep.

name: Scott Park
blurb: Where the Lehigh slips into the Delaware. Sit by the water and watch two rivers become one.

name: Free Bridge
blurb: Walk across to New Jersey and back. Stop halfway and look upriver, especially near sunset.

name: Karl Stirner Arts Trail
blurb: A paved path along the Bushkill Creek, with sculpture tucked in between the trees.

name: Lantern & Loaf
blurb: Warm pastries, egg sandwiches and a cocoa menu for the kids. Get there before the croissants run out.

name: Canal Lock Coffee
blurb: Pour-overs done slowly and big tables for spreading out a laptop.

name: Bluestone Noodle Bar
blurb: Hand-pulled noodles and dumplings. Fast at lunch, cozy at dinner.

name: Marigold Trattoria
blurb: Fresh pasta, a short wine list and twelve candlelit tables. Book ahead.

name: Gaslight Wine Bar
blurb: Wine by the glass, a cheese board and room to linger.

name: Low Bridge Cocktail Room
blurb: Seasonal cocktails and good zero-proof ones too, open till midnight a block from the river.

name: Kindling Pizza
blurb: Wood-fired pies, high chairs, and a corner where the kids can color on the walls.

name: Tinplate Diner
blurb: Breakfast all day and booths that fit the whole family.

name: Third Street Records
blurb: New and used vinyl, with listening stations and the occasional in-store set.

name: Paper Kite Toys
blurb: Wooden toys and puzzles, plus a free play table in back for when little legs need a break.

name: Iron Ore Books
blurb: New and used books, a deep shelf of local history and story time on Saturdays.

name: Northside Plants
blurb: Houseplants, pots and someone who'll help you repot.

name: Halftone Print Studio
blurb: Shirts, posters and merch, printed by hand. Thursday nights the studio's open to anyone.

name: Juniper Lane Photography
blurb: Portraits, small events and product shots for local shops.

name: Fieldnote Design Co.
blurb: Logos, menus, signs and websites for the businesses down the street.

name: Riverlight Recording
blurb: Recording, mixing and podcasts in a converted rowhouse.

name: Sign of the Forks
blurb: Hand-lettered windows, gold leaf and wall signs, the way storefronts used to look.

name: Mosaic Event Collective
blurb: Weddings, pop-ups and block parties, planned and run on the day so you can enjoy it.

name: Open Stage Lessons
blurb: Local players teaching guitar, piano, voice and drums. Kids welcome.
